listing.name: Doraemon Story of Seasons: Friends of the Great Kingdom (MacNativePorts)
listing.summary: Build Friends of the Great Kingdom on an Apple silicon Mac from your own Switch game files. The project reports reaching the opening and leaving Nobita’s house. It has no complete player release, and later rendering remains unconfirmed.
listing.original_game_title: Doraemon Story of Seasons: Friends of the Great Kingdom

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Prepare title 0100F5E0177AC000, your keys, rewritten modules, extracted ExeFS and RomFS, fonts and the project’s per-game hash manifest. The exact accepted version is unconfirmed.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Use Xcode Command Line Tools, Python and the project’s make prepare, runtime and boot targets with GAME=dora. You manage the local build and later updates.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports the title screen, terms and save functions. Terrain, shadows, transparency and postprocessing still need testing. Windows, Linux and iOS players are unconfirmed.
